title: `Flopper.dent` — external `Vow.kiss` call inside bid path couples auction liveness to Vow state
impact: On the first `dent`, `Flopper` makes two external calls to `bids[id].guy` (assumed to be the `Vow`): `VowLike(guy).Ash()` and `VowLike(guy).kiss(min(bid, Ash))`. If `guy` is not a `Vow` (mis-kicked `gal`), or `Vow.kiss` reverts (e.g. `rad > vat.dai(vow)` surplus constraint, or `Ash` accounting mismatch), the entire `dent` reverts — the debt auction cannot receive its first bid and the system cannot clear `Ash`. This is a state-dependent DoS on debt auctions. Additionally, `kiss` mutates `Ash` and calls `vat.heal` mid-`dent`, before `bids[id].guy = msg.sender` is written — a re-entrancy surface into `Flopper` state.
